title: 13-Day Greece & Ancient Turkey Heritage Route
metaDescription: Travel from Athens, Mykonos and Santorini to Ephesus, Pamukkale, Pergamon, Troy and Istanbul on a 13-day journey through two ancient worlds.
breadcrumb: Explore Our Travel Destinations & Multi-Country Tours
summary:
The 13-Day Turkey & Greece Discovery Tour begins in Greece before crossing the Aegean for an overland journey through western Turkey. Explore Athens, then continue to Mykonos and Santorini with overnight island stays rather than cruise calls. From Greece, travel to the Turkish Aegean for ancient Ephesus and Pamukkale before following the historical route north through Pergamon and Troy. Istanbul completes the journey with its Byzantine and Ottoman heritage.
Travel dates and pacing can be adapted around flight and ferry connections. Selected 4-star hotels, daily breakfast, English-speaking local guides, entrance fees during guided visits, scheduled flights and ferries, airport and port transfers and planned sightseeing are included.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Athens
itinerary.text:
Upon arrival at Athens Airport, meet our representative and transfer to your hotel.
Check-in is available after 14:00. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Athens.

itinerary.title: Athens City Tour
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel.
Departure at 07:45 for a half-day tour of Athens, including the Acropolis of Athens, Parthenon, and Acropolis Museum. Continue past the Parliament, Tomb of the Unknown Soldier, Presidential Palace, Panathenaic Stadium, Temple of Olympian Zeus, and Arch of Hadrian. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Athens.

itinerary.title: Ferry to Mykonos
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel, then transfer to the port in Athens for your ferry to Mykonos.
Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Mykonos.

itinerary.title: Free Day in Mykonos
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Enjoy a free day to explore Mykonos at your own pace. Wander through the charming whitewashed streets of Mykonos Town, discover boutique shops, waterfront cafés, and local restaurants, or relax on one of the island’s beautiful beaches. In the evening, enjoy the lively atmosphere and famous nightlife that Mykonos is known for. Overnight in Mykonos.

itinerary.title: Ferry from Mykonos to Santorini
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel, then transfer to the port in Mykonos for your ferry to Santorini.
Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Santorini.

itinerary.title: Free day in Santorini
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel.
Enjoy a free day at leisure in Santorini to relax on the beaches or explore the charming town of Fira.
Optional boat or bus excursions to the volcano and nearby islands are available.
Overnight in Santorini.

itinerary.title: Flight to Izmir
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel and free time until transfer to the airport in Santorini.
Flight with Aegean Airlines via Athens to Izmir.
Upon arrival, meet and transfer to your hotel in Kusadasi.
The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Kusadasi.

itinerary.title: Tour of Ephesus and House of Virgin Mary
itinerary.text: After breakfast, the tour starts at 09:00. Visit Ephesus through the Magnesia Gate and explore highlights including the Odeon, Library of Celsus, Temple of Hadrian, Fountain of Trajan, and the Great Theatre where Saint Paul once preached. Continue to the ruins of the Temple of Artemis, followed by lunch and a visit to the House of the Virgin Mary. Overnight in Kusadasi

itinerary.title: Day trip to Pamukkale & Hierapolis
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 07:30, depart for Pamukkale to explore its famous white travertine terraces and the ancient city of Hierapolis. Guests may also enjoy swimming at the famous Cleopatra Antique Pools (optional, extra entrance fee applies). After the tour, drive back to Kusadasi. Overnight in Kusadasi.

itinerary.title: Pergamon & Canakkale
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 09:00, depart for Pergamon and explore its impressive Acropolis, including the Temple of Athena, ancient Library, Altar of Zeus, Temple of Trajan, and the world’s steepest ancient theatre. Enjoy views of the Red Basilica before lunch in town. After the tour, continue to Canakkale. Overnight in Canakkale.

itinerary.title: Troy & Gallipoli, Transfer to Istanbul
itinerary.text: Visit the ancient city of Troy, including the famous Trojan Horse, city walls, Temple of Athena, Roman Baths, and Odeon. Continue to Eceabat for lunch before the guided Gallipoli campaign Battlefields Tour, visiting Anzac Cove, Lone Pine Memorial, The Nek, and Chunuk Bair. After the tour, transfer to Istanbul. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Istanbul Old City Walking Tour
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 08:30, enjoy a guided tour of Istanbul. Visit the historic Hippodrome of Constantinople, including the Egyptian Obelisk, Serpentine Column, and Fountain of Wilhelm II. Continue to the iconic Blue Mosque and the magnificent Hagia Sophia. After lunch, explore the atmospheric Basilica Cistern, famous for its ancient columns and underground beauty. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Departure from Istanbul
itinerary.text:
After breakfast, check out from the hotel before 12:00 pm.
Transfer to Istanbul Airport according to your flight departure time.

faqs.q: What destinations are included in the 13-Day Turkey and Greece Discovery Tour?
faqs.a: The 13-Day Turkey and Greece Discovery Tour covers Athens, Mykonos, Santorini, Ephesus, Pamukkale, Pergamon, Troy, and Istanbul. You will explore Greece's ancient capital and world-famous islands before continuing to Turkey to visit Ephesus, Pamukkale's thermal terraces, the ancient city of Pergamon, the legendary city of Troy, and the historic treasures of Istanbul. The tour runs for 12 nights and 13 days.

faqs.q: How much does the 13-Day Turkey and Greece Discovery Tour cost?
faqs.a: The tour starts from 3,095 euros per person for the 2026 season. The price includes accommodation, domestic flights, the international flight between Greece and Turkey, ferry tickets between the Greek islands, guided tours, entrance fees, selected meals, and all airport, hotel, and port transfers. Final pricing may vary depending on travel dates and hotel availability.

faqs.q: Are flights and ferry tickets included in this 13-day itinerary?
faqs.a: Yes, the package includes domestic flights, the international flight between Greece and Turkey, and ferry transportation between Athens, Mykonos, and Santorini. These travel arrangements are designed to minimize travel time while allowing you to experience multiple destinations comfortably.

faqs.q: What kind of accommodation does the tour provide?
faqs.a: The package includes 12 nights at carefully selected 4-star hotels and boutique accommodations with daily breakfast. Hotels are chosen for their comfort, quality, and convenient locations near major attractions and transportation hubs. All airport, hotel, and port transfers are included throughout the tour.

faqs.q: Does the 13-day Turkey and Greece tour include a guide?
faqs.a: Yes, professional English-speaking guides are included during the scheduled sightseeing tours. Your guides provide historical insights, cultural context, and local knowledge while ensuring a smooth and enjoyable experience throughout Greece and Turkey.

faqs.q: Is this tour suitable for first-time visitors to Turkey and Greece?
faqs.a: Yes, this tour is ideal for first-time visitors looking for a comprehensive introduction to both countries. It combines Greece's famous islands and ancient landmarks with Turkey's rich archaeological sites and cultural treasures, creating a diverse and memorable travel experience.

faqs.q: How fit do I need to be for the 13-day tour?
faqs.a: The physical difficulty is moderate. Travelers should be comfortable walking through archaeological sites, historic city centers, and areas with uneven surfaces, including Ephesus, Pergamon, Troy, Pamukkale, and the Acropolis. Most travelers in average health can comfortably participate.

faqs.q: Are Mykonos and Santorini included in the tour?
faqs.a: Yes, both Mykonos and Santorini are included in the itinerary. You will have the opportunity to experience Mykonos' charming whitewashed streets and vibrant atmosphere, as well as Santorini's famous caldera views, picturesque villages, and spectacular sunsets.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy for the Turkey and Greece Discovery Tour?
faqs.a: You can cancel free of charge up to 30 days before the tour departure date. Cancellations made within 30 days may be subject to fees according to the booking terms and cancellation policy. Travel insurance is recommended for additional flexibility and protection.

faqs.q: Is the 13-Day Turkey and Greece Discovery Tour available all year and can it be customized?
faqs.a: The tour operates throughout the year, subject to seasonal ferry schedules, and can be customized to suit your preferences. You can extend your stay in Athens, Mykonos, Santorini, or Istanbul, upgrade hotel categories, add optional excursions, or modify the itinerary. Contact Magnificent Travel for a personalized itinerary and quotation.
